[[File:Dan Tartaglione (community card).jpg|thumb|right|220px|Dan Tartaglione, from the community card ''Dan T''.]]
'''Dan Tartaglione''' (GEMP handle '''DTartagOne''') finished '''#8''' at the [[2024 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-2024WorldChampionship" /> He also finished '''17th''' in [[2024 Retro League Event 1|Event 1 of the 2024 Retro League]]<ref name="p1422388" /> and '''#44''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 64; Challonge seed 43).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref> He is a member of the [[Killer Bees]].<ref name="slack-kb">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Garrett Larson (deadbody), Dan Tartaglione (DTartagOne), Robbie Hendon. Quotes: "Me and Dan and Robbie"; Hendon wrote that he is on Killer Bees; Tartaglione posted "The Killer Bee's Suite is open" at 2024 Worlds</ref>

He led the Stream Team that covered every match of the [[2021 Outrider Cup]] live<ref name="oc2021" /> and led the streaming efforts at the [[2023 Outrider Cup III]].<ref name="oc3">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/outrider-cup-iii-wrap-up-victory-for-team-usa/ Outrider Cup III Wrap-up: Victory for Team USA], starwarsccg.org (9 February 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20240626231445/https://www.starwarsccg.org/outrider-cup-iii-wrap-up-victory-for-team-usa/ Wayback Machine]</ref> With [[Garrett Larson]], he provided streaming and commentary coverage of the [[2026 Boston Winter Classic]]<ref name="bwc26">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-boston-winter-classic-wrap-up-phil-aasen-victorious/ 2026 Boston Winter Classic Wrap-up – Phil Aasen Victorious], starwarsccg.org (30 January 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261011191428/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-boston-winter-classic-wrap-up-phil-aasen-victorious.html Internet Archive]</ref> and [[2026 San Diego Super Open]].<ref name="sdso26">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-san-diego-super-open-wrap-up-joe-olson-conquers/ 2026 San Diego Super Open Wrap-up – Joe Olson Conquers], starwarsccg.org (28 April 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261011191508/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2026-san-diego-super-open-wrap-up-joe-olson-conquers.html Internet Archive]</ref>
